model_family: 2D Epileptor network (vep-stim vep_mcmc lineage, diffusive coupling) inverted with Stan NUTS; patched copy vep_ar1.stan v2 (sha256 f15d0a54...0efb) with AR(1) observation model and data-centred priors

hypotheses.fitted: single network model with per-region x0 (H1-H4 are discriminated by the x0 posterior)

fitting_partitions: development partition only (P1-derived synthetic case, A0011). No P2 signals, no vault, no reserved files, no study-001 files.
observation_model: Obs[t,s] = amp * (gain (x_t - x_1))[s] + u[s] + r[t,s]; r[1,s] ~ N(0, sigma/sqrt(1-phi^2)); r[t,s] ~ N(phi r[t-1,s], sigma) for t >= 2, all channels and all time points. Features: 10 Hz high-pass Butterworth order 3 filtfilt -> log of centred 1.0 s moving mean of squares (reflect edges, no zero padding) -> 1 Hz low-pass order 3 filtfilt -> decimate to 2 Hz. No outlier clamping. Feature is log power; Stan does not log it again.

priors.x0: x0_mu=-2.5, x0_sd=0.5 (x0 = x0_mu + x0_sd * N(0,1), identity instead of eig)
priors.z_init: z_eq(softmin(x0, x0_cap=-2.12; cap_k=20), I1) + z0_sd * N(0,1), z0_sd=0.2; x_init on the resting branch for z_init
priors.amp: logamp_mu = log(q99 over channels of (max feature - baseline median) / (2.4 * max gain)), logamp_sd=1
priors.u: u_mu = per-channel median of the first 5 s of the feature, u_sd=0.5
priors.sigma: logsig_mu = log(median over channels of SD of the first 5 s), logsig_sd=1

max x0 R-hat 4.73, all 162 x0 R-hat >= 1.05, min bulk ESS 17: the 16 chains stayed near their 16 distinct starting optima (no mixing)

qualification_verdict.diagnosis: posterior is strongly multimodal (24/24 L-BFGS runs ended at distinct optima, lp 836-1254) and the EZ vs propagation-zone ordering is weakly identified with the 2D model on 6D-generated data (strong fitted coupling K ~ 18-35 synchronises EZ and PZ); amplitude-vs-extent and the 2D/6D model mismatch remain. With the compute available (200+200 iterations, depth 8) convergence cannot be reached.
qualification_verdict.consequence: per the frozen skill and protocol A0001, the pipeline is not qualified; P2 fitting with this model should not be interpreted as EZ recovery evidence (LEAD/R5 decide).
